beliefs.claim: The engine gives agents no way to delete an existing file: the Bash hook refuses rm, and Edit/Write cannot remove a file. Tasks whose Files list says "Delete:" (task 3's M1, likely task 2's too) cannot pass their facts from an agent copy.

Task 3 M1 cannot be met by agents: rules forbid shell deletes and no tool removes files. Six paths need deletion by operator/engine: skills/ultrapowers/kernel/{fold_wave.py,repo_weave.py,frontier_fold.py,hunks.py,FOLD_LOG.md}, tests/test_fold_wave_anchor.py.

Agents cannot delete files: the PreToolUse hook in factory/flock/engine.mjs denies any Bash `rm`/`mv`, and Edit/Write cannot remove a file. So a task whose Files list Delete: entries (task 2: 39 files) can never pass facts that check those files are gone.
